claims: Alex Palou won the 2026 Acura Grand Prix of Long Beach on April 19, 2026.

Felix Rosenqvist was the pole-sitter.

Nick Yelloly and Renger van der Zande drove Meyer Shank Racing's No. 93 Acura ARX-06.
Alex Palou took the lead after a lap 58 pit stop during a caution period.
